findings.issue: With JavaScript disabled the form has no action/method and disables native validation; ordinary submit performs default GET to current contact URL with entered fields. Script-only copy button also appears enabled without a handler.

findings.fix: Native mailto action with localized subject, POST/textplain, native validation until hydration, localized noscript/direct email; disable clipboard action until hydration. Existing CSP already permits mailto.
